name: F-22 Raptor
summary: Twin-engine stealth air-superiority fighter, the first operational fifth-generation fighter, flown only by the US Air Force.

wings: Large diamond-shaped wing: swept leading edge with a forward-swept trailing edge
Mid-mounted, blending smoothly into the flat fuselage sides
Planform edges aligned with the tail surfaces for stealth
engines: Two engines with flat, rectangular two-dimensional thrust-vectoring nozzles
Large parallelogram-shaped intakes on each side, raked sharply back below the canopy
fuselage: Broad, flat-sided fuselage with a sharp chined nose
Large frameless bubble canopy, often gold-tinted
Internal weapons bays; normally no external stores
tail: Twin large vertical fins canted outward, set wide apart
Large diamond-shaped all-moving horizontal tails extending to the rear of the nozzles

tellTales: Diamond-shaped wings and tails with matching angled edges
Large sharply raked intakes on both sides below a frameless canopy

confusedWith.howToTell: The F-22 is larger and flatter with two rectangular nozzles and diamond wings; the F-35 has a single round sawtooth nozzle and a fatter body.
The F-22 has outward-canted fins, angular stealth edges and flat nozzles; the F-15 has upright fins, boxy intakes and round nozzles.

usCount.source: USAF FY2026 budget / Air & Space Forces Magazine
